description: Defines data structures and functions related to UL-SCH (Uplink Shared Channel) information and configuration in a 3GPP NR (New Radio) context, including parameters for calculating UL-SCH info and effective code rate.

classes.name: ulsch_configuration
classes.description: Contains parameters necessary for UL-SCH calculation, such as transport block size, MCS, resource blocks, DM-RS type, and other transmission parameters.

classes.name: ulsch_information
classes.description: Holds derived UL-SCH parameters, including resource element counts, bits, and a method to compute the effective code rate.

methods.name: get_effective_code_rate
methods.description: Calculates the normalized effective code rate for UL-SCH based on current configuration and resource allocations.

methods.name: get_ulsch_information
methods.description: Function to obtain UL-SCH information given a specific UL-SCH configuration.
